en-US.name: Taste Skill (DesireCore fork)
en-US.summary: Build websites and landing pages with the v2.5.0 component kit and manual browser checks. Requires Node.js 22+ and Chrome, Edge or Chromium; FFmpeg is optional. Online media, maps and fonts use external providers. Keep the relevant asset licenses and credits.

zh-CN.name: Taste Skill（DesireCore 维护版）
zh-CN.summary: 基于 v2.5.0 构建网站和落地页，提供组件、样式与手动浏览器检查。需 Node.js 22+ 和 Chrome、Edge 或 Chromium，FFmpeg 可选。在线素材、地图与字体走第三方服务，发布时保留素材许可和署名。

requirements.value: Separately install Node.js 22+ and Chrome, Edge or Chromium (or set CHROME_PATH) for manually invoked screenshot and consistency checks. FFmpeg is optional for some image workflows. Reports and chosen presets are written in the project.

Optional photo tools use Wikimedia Commons and Lorem Picsum. The icon resolver uses version-pinned sources via jsDelivr. Live map baking calls a configured OpenStreetMap Overpass endpoint with the selected location. Generated pages may request Google Fonts. Supply local assets or omit an unavailable integration.

Keep the asset notices, applicable license texts and credits for copied images, SVGs and map data. Trademark and asset provider terms apply to publishing. Project scripts run on explicit invocation, and the fork includes no automatic Stop hook.
